failed_or_abandoned: The assignment's Lambda_D^3/m_Q^2 heavy-light scaling was not used: HQET fixes delta ~ Lambda^2/m_Q and the B/D and Sigma_b/Sigma_c data confirm the 1/m_Q law to 5%
A genuine spin-0 -> spin-1 NREFT response is not available in WimPyDD; the spin-1/2 MiDM operator basis is used with an O(1) spin-factor caveat
Millicharge bounds for the Coulombic dark atom and glueball-decay cosmology for the heavy-light scenario were left qualitative
